suite: Equivalent under conditions: VeriEQL LeetCode (every 8th case)
score: 374 cases proved only under conditions beyond the declared ones, 0 wrong
metric: Of 3,000 cases (every eighth of 23,994), the 2,071 the prover does not prove outright with the spec's own types, keys, NOT NULL columns and foreign keys (929 are proved outright): 374 proved under a minimal set of extra NOT NULL, unique-key and foreign-key conditions, 1,697 unknown (1,690 with no proof, and 7 conditional proofs the executed check cannot re-check (not scored: 5 rest on a composite foreign key it cannot impose, 2 hold only when a column is NOT NULL and make both queries constant on every test database)).
correctness: 0 wrong, 0 crashed: every conditional proof re-run on 900 random DuckDB databases repaired to meet its conditions and on the executed counterexample search with the conditions in the spec, both with no difference; the prover loses each proof when any one condition is dropped; 101 are separated by a database that breaks the conditions
caveats: A sample, not the whole set (3,000 of 23,994 cases). Proof under assumed conditions beyond the declared ones. No held-out split reserved; the harness was developed against Singh dev pairs and an early 80-case sample (tuned on test). Conditions beyond the spec are rarer than on the Singh pairs because the declared keys already carry what the prover can use. Measured 2026-11-12 on commit 395b5c1 (hardest-cases batch 3, Kumo_SQL_Prover PR 20), with main 0e94662 measured the same way on the same sample as the baseline (879 outright, 335 conditional, 1,781 unknown, 5 not re-checkable): no pair moved the other way; 50 unknown pairs became outright proofs, 39 unknown pairs conditional, and two pairs that a database separated before (they differ only on a row whose column is NULL) now read as conditional on that column being NOT NULL and are not re-checkable. On the first measurement (2026-10-04) the count was 297.
